dogecoin.text:
13/ I expect I am wrong,
that Elon's cult following will help push Dogecoin back to $0.75 and close to a $1.
It's just the nature of the cult of cryptocurrency.
But if it does not, it's quite the ego disaster for Elon, and he knows it.

12/ If Elon can't quickly manipulate Dogecoin back to $0.75 to $1, he just might get even more reckless.

He's going to make a lot of people nervous.

@timothy_skim @elonmusk He can't.
Elon must get the price of Dogecoin back to where he crashed it on SNL.
He's in a panic now.
It's not about $D, it's about his reputation now.
And that's dangerous for Tesla and SpaceX.

7/ So now it is not just a matter of profit, Elon Musk must now boost the price of the speculative asset Dogecoin (a joke/meme asset) to protect his reputation, as CEO of Tesla/SpaceX.

Everyone knows this kind of panic could have the opposite affect and tank Dogecoin.

1/ The problem for @elonmusk right now is not just the obvious market manipulation of Dogecoin.
The problem is he is a CEO of 2 public corps, which likely own the coin he is manipulating, and he has directly tied his corps to the manipulation. https://t.co/2L566bAcqU

Dogecoin is down 65% since @elonmusk was proclaiming himself the Dogefather and using @nbcsnl to promote it.
More like the Dogeundertaker. https://t.co/HhEGBUrJgo

Is it a dip, or is it a slope?
#Dogecoin
#BitcoinCrash

7/ So now we sit at a very key point where Bitcoin is vulnerable below a resistance point & has shown a Gravestone Doji on the weekly chart. And yes the price of Dogecoin is largely coupled to Bitcoin and other crypto.
Will Elon Musk & others try to protect the price of Bitcoin? https://t.co/tzyziO01TB

6/ Sadly the press is happy to talk about Elon Musk using @nbcsnl to promote Dogecoin and crypto, but they don't seem to be be taking much about the retail traders who trusted Musk, bought at 60¢ to 70¢, only to watch it crash to 18¢. https://t.co/gSj1fXYx7L

Seems like Bitcoin & Dogecoin are wound up for a move.
Waiting for a tweet from a player ... https://t.co/ej2F6BvvTF

Looks like Dogecoin may have decoupled from Bitcoin a bit at a precarious level.
I'd be really nervous right now if I held any.

There are a lot of big players who need to protect Bitcoin to protect their own interests, as miners or coinholders.

Dogecoin, not so much.
